product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires specialized professional-services firms and builds in-house AI and workflow automation for their accounting, tax and advisory professionals to reduce manual work and improve client service.
product_one_liner.notes: It combines firm ownership, technology and service delivery rather than selling standalone software to outside firms.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the site navigation or footer, and the pricing URL returned no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The launch announcement's customer-success story identifies only one end client, Keith Robinson of portfolio firm Citrine. Acquired portfolio firms are not counted as external customers.

employee_band.notes: Based on 37 employees shown in the company profile.

eng_blog.notes: The Ideas index contains business, leadership and career commentary, not at least two engineer-authored product-build posts.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link appears in the site navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings have no qualifying AI, ML or data-science titles; product-engineering roles do involve AI work.

model_provider.notes: No named provider or model found in the technology page, blog article, engineering posting, terms or privacy policy; these discuss AI and third-party providers generically.

compliance_certs.notes: No requested certification claims found. The privacy policy references UK GDPR transfer safeguards, rather than claiming certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 4, 2026; led by The General Partnership.

raised_18mo.notes: The $35 million Series B announced August 4, 2026 falls within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The board lists a Sales & Business Development Associate, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch appears in the six-month window. The latest explicit public-launch announcement found is dated June 18, 2025; newer articles are thought leadership.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 4, 2026, Multiplier announced that former Slack CFO Allen Shim had joined as President and CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Rooled.com sales posting explicitly requires maintaining its HubSpot CRM.
